title: Falcons Reacts Survey: Projecting Zachariah Branch’s rookie year

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons Reacts Survey: Projecting Zachariah Branch’s rookie year
sources.description: Welcome to SB Nation Reacts, a survey of fans across the NFL. Throughout the year we ask questions of the most plugged-in Falcons fans and fans across the country. One of the top training camp standouts so far has been Zachariah Branch. The rookie wide receiver is turning heads with his explosiveness, route-running, and hands. […]
